x: 08-09 Sunday Mail Scottish Champs. & Trials, Scotstoun, Glasgow. a=8th, b=9th. 400m: b 3 I Deeth 48.2 (ht a 48.94). 800m: a 2h2 V.Wilson 1:54.97. 1500m: b 2 D.Watson (U20) 3:51.73 (ht a 3:54.79); hts D.Malin (U20) 4:11.19.

U17 Set Osho demonstrated what a talent he is by winning the B in 48.8 seconds, faster than Ian Deeth's winning time in the A (49.3). Matt Douglas and Ryan Dinham showed total control in the lap hurdles and Matt's time was a Southern League record, beating the time set by Mark Bishop 13 years ago.
Ryan Dinham was feeling the effects of his earlier event but gave 110%, as too did Ian Deeth who has returned to the team after a five year absence.
Men. 100m: 5r1 I Deeth 11.59; 3r2 I Akindele 11.22. 200m: 2r2 I Akindele 22.37; 4r4 R McMillan 29.21. 400m: 5r2 R McMillan 63.40; 2r2 I Deeth 49.86.
Men. 400m: 4rA I Deeth 51.11; 5rB J Blackledge 52.73; 3rD C Minn 53.03; 6rE R Poulter 56.97. 800m: 3rA S Omar 1:53.58; 7rB K O'Connell 1:58.80.

Led off by Ian Deeth who gamely came along just to run the relays, the 4x100 men were headed by Windsor – who were then dq'd.
